friend_2/poem12: SKIPPED, no rig: no whole-figure painting exists. family.12.friend_2.body holds loose limb, garment and shoe cards (vest, shorts, thighs, shins, feet) and family.12.friend_2.heads-hands holds facial features only (eye pairs, brows, mouths): not even a whole head. Assembling a body from those would invent a figure and a face; not done.
